name: amd_studio_vs_bline
description:
Generate specs/amd_studio_vs_bline.json: Unsloth Studio vs BlineUI on gfx1151, per family, same prompt / seed /
steps / size at BlineUI's template operating point (outputs/bline_defaults_audit.md; templates read from
blineui_workflow_templates_json at the pinned BlineUI commit).

Arms per family (tag = <fam>_<arm>):
  s_def     Studio, its defaults (attention auto -> diffusers native -> torch SDPA; AOTriton on ROCm)
  s_flash   Studio with attention_backend="flash" (DAO-AILab flash-attention, Triton AMD backend). On main the
            ROCm gate drops the request (falls back to native); on the patched head it engages.
  c_def     BlineUI, README ROCm install (download.pytorch.org/whl/rocm7.2 torch), default flags
  c_rock    BlineUI, AMD gfx1151 torch (repo.amd.com/rocm/whl/gfx1151, the build Studio installs), default flags
  c_flash   c_rock + --use-flash-attention (same DAO-AILab Triton AMD build) + --enable-dynamic-vram
  c_kitchen c_rock + --use-ck-attention (Bline Kitchen INT8 attention, quantized) + --enable-dynamic-vram

Every BlineUI file is public (token=False); each family's Studio repo is public too (FLUX.1-schnell via the
unsloth mirror, since black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-schnell is gated).
